main_text.p: ad simulachra colenda compellebant, adeo ut nemo illius temporis calamita-tes (teste {1}Oratione in laudem Hieron. Nazianzeno)pro rei indigni-tate satis commemorare, ac deplorare queat : [Nunquam, quicquam tale au-ditum est in Orbe terrarum, neq; quif-quam, unquam istiusmodi mala exper-tus est, (clamat {m}Epist.ad Orthodoxos & in apologiâ ad Constantium. Athanasius,) Tanta si-quidem immanitas fuit, ut Virgines de-nudarint, corporaque plagis interfecto-rum aliquandiu ad sepulturam reddere negauerint ; sed foris obijcerent cani-bus, donec depensa ingenti mulcta, clan-culum à necessarijs subducerentur. Magnus ibi in distinguendis cadaueri-bus labor,cò quo[?] nemo suos agnosce-ret; cętera quę facta sunt incredibila,& tam tetra,ut sensu audientis obstupefa-ciant. Ego mihi imperare non potui,in-quit alibi idem Author, quin paucis ea quoque delinearem, quo plane vobis constraret,nullo vnquam tempore talia in Ecclesia perpetrata esse, ex quo Sal-vator noster in cœlum eueĉtus[?] Discipu-lis præcepit: ite,& docete omnes Gentes,] Quid interim in has angustiùs redacti Catholici? quùm Magnus Athanasius E-piscopus

page.notes: The superscript marks 1 (after "teste") and m (after "clamat") are keyed to the two left-margin notes. The bracket before "Nunquam" is printed. Marginal note text is italic. Doubtful readings: "quo[?]" (the mark after "quo" may be a raised d or another abbreviation sign); "eueĉtus[?]" (the ct ligature is unclear). The bracket after "Gentes," is printed as shown. The spelling of u/v and long s has been normalised as instructed.
